fields.statement: Scratch binary built from 96a0eabf3 (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa2), run in a scratch clone with TMPDIR set to an empty folder, once with no index path (XDG_CACHE_HOME=relative) and once with a read-only cache folder. status --json and inbox --json answer (status counts 14 accepted/40 draft/1 proposed in both modes; inbox items []) and leave 0 rhiza-projection-* folders; during inbox two throwaway folders exist and both are gone at exit. On ~/code/rhiza after one warming run: status 0.06 s, inbox 0.67 s (base build at merge-base 9064447e1: 0.65 s), check 13.45 s and then 9.56 s (base 11.18 s), load about 4 on 4 cores. No regression against base; inbox and check are still over milestone 39's 200 ms/5 s targets, which these leaves do not claim.

Scratch binary built from 96a0eabf3 (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa2), run in a scratch clone with TMPDIR set to an empty folder, once with no index path (XDG_CACHE_HOME=relative) and once with a read-only cache folder. Every read below runs through the projection with no fold fallback. go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/api -run '^(TestPropertyProjectionParity|TestProjection.*)$' passes (8.6 s). Error paths all answer cleanly with 0 leftovers: change show of an unknown ID gives not_found (next rhiza change ls), session show and run status of a missing ID give not_found, and slice --change unknown gives not_found.

Scratch binary built from 96a0eabf3 (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa2), run in a scratch clone with TMPDIR set to an empty folder, once with no index path (XDG_CACHE_HOME=relative) and once with a read-only cache folder. With no index path and with a read-only cache: inbox (gate read), session ls, run status (no runs: not_found, next rhiza run start) and ship check --model-conflict --change 01M7GFTK (detail 'no model conflict is recorded'; without --change: usage error) answer and leave 0 rhiza-projection-* folders in TMPDIR.

Scratch binary built from 96a0eabf3 (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa2), run in a scratch clone with TMPDIR set to an empty folder, once with no index path (XDG_CACHE_HOME=relative) and once with a read-only cache folder. status, change show, show --change, inbox, slice, session and run status and ship check --model-conflict, in both modes, leave 0 rhiza-projection-* folders afterwards, error paths included. Failure: with TMPDIR chmod 555, status exits 1 with 'no index path; throwaway index in <TMPDIR>: mkdir ... permission denied', naming both.

Scratch binary built from 96a0eabf3 (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa2), run in a scratch clone with TMPDIR set to an empty folder, once with no index path (XDG_CACHE_HOME=relative) and once with a read-only cache folder. With no index path: apply --dry-run of an add, an add and a link from the second add to the first resolves the link through the pending overlay (rc 0, 2 nodes, 1 link). The real apply writes it and show qa-probe-a --change shows the 'verified by' link. apply of a missing file gives a usage error. show of an unknown handle gives not_found (next rhiza ls). All leave 0 leftovers.
